steps.name: preflight-source-branch
steps.command: git status --short --branch && git rev-parse HEAD && git log -1 --oneline && git diff --check

steps.name: format-changed-components
steps.command: cd frontend && ./node_modules/.bin/prettier --write src/styles/pinned-media.css src/components/map/pinned-media/PinnedMediaDrawer.tsx e2e/visual/discovery-drawer.spec.ts && ./node_modules/.bin/prettier --check src/styles/pinned-media.css src/components/map/pinned-media/PinnedMediaDrawer.tsx e2e/visual/discovery-drawer.spec.ts

verify_steps.name: full-frontend-and-drawer-browser-regression
verify_steps.command: cd frontend && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build && E2E_CHROME_EXECUTABLE='/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome' ../scripts/quality/e2e.sh e2e/visual/discovery-drawer.spec.ts e2e/visual/pinned-media-drawer.spec.ts
